appearance_notes: Phase9 original asymmetric refined physical gallbladder; all mechanics require fresh qualification.
Dynamic display: smooth radial-saturated PN, at most 0.12 mm from current physical triangles; support-welded normals of actual displayed triangles.
Original multiscale tissue colour/finish; smooth non-contact omental lobules, no baked lighting or photographed pixels.
Liver physical and bounded display geometry are retained from Phase8; new attachment points bind to its actual triangles.
Synthetic local anatomy and engineering mechanical/optical parameters; clinical calibration and human visual approval pending.

orientation.x: lateral (simulation axis, not a patient DICOM axis)
orientation.y: fundus to neck; left tool enters from negative Y and right from positive Y in the engineering rig
orientation.scope: local gallbladder working field; not a complete abdomen

dynamic_display.binding: Smooth radial-saturated PN rebuilt from every accepted native state; actual displayed geometry also drives outputs.

phase6_interaction.scope: Engineering interaction rig, not clinical trocar placement guidance.

phase7_liver_revision.construction: Continuous analytic macroform and exact 31-anchor bed; posterior operative field uses a regularized cubic radial fit to accepted height samples, with smooth broad blending and local conforming refinement. Closed matching lower surface.

posterior_field.basis: C2 cubic r^3 radial field plus linear polynomial; exact anchors and regularized non-anchor controls.
posterior_field.source: Accepted Phase 6 operative height samples; macro rim/equator and bad lateral shoulder are not copied into the new collider.
posterior_field.scope: Original engineering reconstruction. Full physical and visual requalification required; no clinical anatomical validation.

phase7_liver_revision.ready_recipe: Original Phase 6 recipe retained; clearance guard unchanged.

phase9_render.scope: Shared scene foundation; no calibrated endoscope or project-specific image degradation.

phase9_material_profile.scope: Synthetic short tissue-scatter authoring profile; not measured tissue optics.
